item.title: Actually, Fashion Week Has Always Been a Billionaire’s Playground
item.description: Read José Criales-Unzueta’s column on style and fashion that will examine its intersections with power, culture, and society.

item.title: All the Looks Kendall Jenner Has Worn to the Vanity Fair Oscar Party
item.description: On the Vanity Fair Oscar Party red carpet, the model has previously opted to wear black.

item.description: “I never considered…that my deeper entry into the Getty world would rob me of my own hard-earned story,” the California governor writes in Young Man in a Hurry: A Memoir of Discovery.

item.description: The Royal Court creator teases her VF Oscar Party outfit (“nipple tassles”) and shares her interview targets: “Jacob Elordi, the gentle giant, you can trust me.”

item.title: A History of Violence: How Hollywood Has Protested War at Awards Shows
item.description: Several Iranian filmmakers will be present at this year’s Oscars, and some are urging celebrities to “speak out about what is happening in Iran.”

item.description: The podcaster and comedian can’t wait to cohost the Oscar party livestream with Quenlin Blackwell and Brittany Broski: “I’m very anxious, but I’m very excited about it.”

item.title: How to Watch the Vanity Fair Oscar Party 2026 Livestream
item.description: Viral internet sensations Quenlin Blackwell, Jake Shane, and Brittany Broski are your hosts for Vanity Fair’s Oscar Party red-carpet livestream. Here’s what you need to know to tune in.

item.title: Inside War-a-Lago, Trump’s Palm Beach Members Club-Turned-Gilded Situation Room
